class.name: NNMetadataSearchCriterion
class.brief_description: Search criterion that filters candidate nodes by a Godot metadata entry.
class.description: Keeps only candidates whose [member metadata_name] metadata equals [member metadata_value] (always scoring [code]1.0[/code]). Use to filter nodes tagged with [method Object.set_meta] (for example, cover type, team, or item category) without writing a custom criterion script.

members.member: Metadata key each candidate node must have.
Required value of the metadata entry. Exposed as a [String] in the inspector; any [Variant] type can be set from code.
